Apple (Call) (AAPL) Shareholder Symmetry Peak Management Increased Position by $2.51 Million; Berkshire Asset Management Upped Its Stake in Microsoft (MSFT) as Shares Rose
May 31, 2018 - By Migdalia James
Frank Slattery increased its stake in Apple Inc (Call) (AAPL) by 60% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Symmetry Peak Management Llc bought 15,000 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Frank Slattery held 40,000 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $6.71M, up from 25,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Symmetry Peak Management Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc (Call) for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $918.49 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.34% or $0.63 $186.87. About 26.72M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
Berkshire Asset Management Llc increased its stake in Microsoft (MSFT) by 2.16% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Berkshire Asset Management Llc bought 9,305 shares as the company’s stock rose 3.08% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 439,367 shares of the prepackaged software company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $40.10M, up from 430,062 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Berkshire Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Microsoft for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $759.41B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.11% or $0.11 $98.84. About 21.83M shares traded. Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT) has risen 41.28% uptrending. It has outperformed by 28.71% the S&P500.
